text:
Samira Gomez: Hi folks, quick ask 94 I99ve been having increased neck pain and my doctor recommended a specific ergonomic chair plus the option to alternate to standing for 30-60m blocks. Can we start an accommodation request?
Liam O'Connor: @Samira thanks for raising. Totally fine to start the process. Do you have a vendor/model recommendation or should Facilities pick?
Samira Gomez: My clinic suggested the "ErgoFlex Pro" (model EF-300). I can upload the clinic note. Prefer the specific chair if possible but open to approved equivalent. Also need a short allowance for 1020 minute micro-breaks every 90 minutes when I'm doing deep work (not during meetings).
Aisha Kaur (People Ops): Hi @Samira 94 start the confidential upload here: https://hr.redwood.internal/secure-upload/EF-2265432100 (expires 72h). Per ADA interactive process, we99ll need the medical note plus the requested accommodation details. We99ll loop Facilities for procurement and your manager for coverage plan.
Facilities Bot: New facilities request created: FAC-9982. Assigned to Facilities queue. Link: https://facilities.redwood.internal/requests/FAC-9982
Marta Chen (HR): I have visibility. FYI procurement of ergonomic equipment may require manager approval for >$500 items; Facilities will route a cost-approval form. We can approve temporary micro-breaks as a reasonable scheduling accommodation; just need manager ack and an agreed communication plan for async availability.
Liam O'Connor: I can sign the ack. For meetings, please block "No-call Focus" windows on your calendar and we'll respect them. Also curious if you want a temporary reduction in meeting load during the intake of new equipment.
Samira Gomez: Yes please reduce recurring non-essential meetings for 4 weeks while I adjust. I'll mark them as optional rather than declining.
Aisha Kaur (People Ops): Process outline we99ll follow (private): 1) upload medical note (Samira) 2) People Ops logs request and opens ticket HR-9982 3) Facilities gets procurement approval if needed 4) Manager ack for schedule adjustments (Liam) 5) Accommodation agreement drafted and signed 6) Review in 8 weeks.
Samira Gomez: Uploaded: "drnote_samira_2026-03-20.pdf" to HR-9982.
Facilities Bot: Facilities note: vendor quoted $675 for ErgoFlex Pro including shipping. Requesting cost approval. (FAC-9982)
Marta Chen (HR): @Liam please confirm you're able to approve up to $700 for chair procurement or confirm an alternative. Also confirm you can temporarily reassign heavy-collab tasks scheduled during Samira's micro-break windows.
Liam O'Connor: Confirmed - I approve up to $700 and will reassign heavy collab tasks for the next 4 weeks. I'll update the project board to reflect this.
Aisha Kaur (People Ops): Great. Samira, we'll draft a brief private accommodation agreement capturing: item procured, break cadence (10-15m every 90m), meeting load reduction period (4 weeks), review at 8 weeks, and confidentiality note. We'll post the draft to HR-9982 and share it with you and Liam for signatures.
Samira Gomez: Appreciate it. One more question 94 will this show up on my public profile or be shared with the team?
Marta Chen (HR): Confidential only. Only your manager, People Ops, Facilities (for procurement), and HR will have access. We do not annotate public profiles.
Liam O'Connor: I'll put a team note in project docs: "Samira on temporary meeting-light plan" without medical details, just to coordinate.
Samira Gomez: Sounds good. Thanks everyone. I feel better having a clear path. :relieved:
People Ops Bot: Reminder: please review and sign the accommodation agreement in ticket HR-9982 within 48 hours once it's posted.
Liam O'Connor: Will sign when it's up.
Samira Gomez: Thanks all.
